summary: First full E2E test run of EraCool AI Financial Analyst. Backend: 53 pytest cases across auth, dashboard, financial statements, KPI/jobs, accounts, audit logs, AI (Gemini), import wizard, reports — 50 passed / 3 failed. All key PRD numbers verified exactly: Revenue Rp181,230,000, Net Profit Rp49,169,996, Net Margin 27.13%, health_score 94, 120 jobs, Balance Sheet balanced=true (197,169,996 = 48,000,000 + 149,169,996). Gemini AI (gemini-3-flash-preview) returns valid structured JSON grounded in engine numbers (quotes 27.13%, Rp49.169.996, Rp181.230.000) — no hallucinated figures observed. Frontend: full E2E on all 13 pages — login/logout, unauth redirect, invalid-credential error, all nav links, charts, balanced badge, KPI tech/customer tabs, jobs search (120 -> 24 filtered), Settings 3 tabs, Import 4-step wizard (upload -> auto-mapping -> validate -> commit -> delete), PDF/XLSX downloads, mobile drawer. Zero console errors (the single 401 logged was the intentional bad-password test).

critical.issue: Persediaan (Inventory, acct 1300) shows a NEGATIVE balance of Rp-25,000,000. demo_data.py seeds opening inventory of Rp20,000,000 and then credits Rp45,000,000 of material usage to 1300 (line 141) but NEVER records any inventory purchase/restock entry. Negative inventory is an accounting impossibility and is highly visible on the Balance Sheet page of a financial-analyst product.

quick_ratio (9.19x) > current_ratio (7.8x) — mathematically impossible. Direct consequence of the negative inventory above (quick_assets = current_assets - negative inventory). Also propagated into AI Insights output as 'Current Ratio 7.8' claims.

Silent data loss on files >20 rows. /api/import/upload returns only preview = df.head(20), and the frontend (Import.js commit()) posts uploaded.preview as rows. Verified: a 25-row CSV reported row_count=25 but only 20 rows were imported and the UI said '0 baris dilewati'. Backend must persist/return the full parsed dataset (or accept a file/upload id) and the UI must not send a truncated preview.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no lockout/throttle (playbook expects 423/429 after 5 failures).

allow_origin_regex='.*' combined with allow_credentials=True reflects any origin while httpOnly cookies are set — playbook requires explicit origin allow-list (CORS_ORIGINS env var exists in backend/.env but is unused).

Refresh only reads the refresh_token cookie; the frontend uses Bearer tokens from localStorage, so refresh is unreachable for the actual client. Access token silently expires after 12h with no renewal path.
Stateless — only clears cookies. A leaked Bearer token remains valid until expiry (no server-side revocation/denylist).
No password strength/minimum-length validation; a 1-character password is accepted.
Every request re-loads ALL journal_lines (to_list(200000)) and recomputes the full engine in Python. Fine for demo volume but will not scale; consider caching or Mongo aggregation.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.

integration_issues.issue: Sends uploaded.preview (max 20 rows) instead of the full file, so rows 21+ are silently dropped and reported as '0 baris dilewati'.

issues: Displays 'Persediaan (Inventory) Rp-25.000.000' — a negative asset line users will read as a bug/red flag.
Currency uses Indonesian separators (Rp181.230.000) but percentages/ratios use US decimals (27.13%, 7.8x, 0.32x). Inconsistent locale within the same card grid.
AI answer metric chips render provider-formatted 'IDR 49,169,996' (US commas) next to app-formatted 'Rp49.169.996' — normalise AI metric values through the same formatIDR helper.
Right-hand card labelled 'Operating Profit' shows the exact same figure as 'Net Profit (Laba Bersih)'; label is ambiguous/duplicative for the demo dataset.
Dashboard KPI card values have no data-testid, so values must be asserted by scraping body text. Add data-testid="kpi-<key>" to each card value for reliable regression testing.

action_items: Fix negative inventory: add inventory purchase/restock journal entries in demo_data.py (or route material COGS through a purchase that debits 1300) so Persediaan stays positive and quick_ratio <= current_ratio.
Fix import truncation: persist the full parsed rows server-side (return an upload_id) or have the frontend send the whole file; never commit only the 20-row preview.
Add login brute-force lockout/throttle (423 or 429 after 5 failed attempts per email/IP).
Restrict CORS to explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS instead of allow_origin_regex='.*' while allow_credentials=True.
Make /api/auth/refresh work with the Bearer/localStorage flow the frontend actually uses, or drop it.
Add minimum password length validation on /api/auth/register.
Normalise number/percent formatting to a single Indonesian locale helper, including AI metric chips.
Add data-testid to dashboard KPI card values.
critical_code_review_comments: demo_data.py:141 credits material usage to acct 1300 with no offsetting purchase debit — root cause of the negative inventory and the impossible quick_ratio > current_ratio.
server.py:346 preview = df.head(20) is the only row payload returned to the client, and Import.js:44 posts uploaded.preview — a truncation contract that guarantees silent data loss for real files.
server.py CORS: allow_origin_regex='.*' + allow_credentials=True is an unsafe combination for a cookie-auth app; CORS_ORIGINS in .env is dead config.
server.py deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown should become a lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.109 deprecation).
Every dashboard/financial endpoint does load_data() on the full journal (to_list(200000)) — no caching, no aggregation; O(n) recompute per page view.
auth.py logout is cookie-only; Bearer tokens are not revocable, so 'logout' is client-side only.

rca_of_the_issue: Negative inventory + impossible quick ratio: generate_demo_lines seeds an opening Persediaan balance of Rp20,000,000 (demo_data.py:84) and then, for each of the 120 jobs, credits the material component of COGS to account 1300 (demo_data.py:141) totalling Rp45,000,000, with the debit going to COGS Material. Because no purchase entry ever debits 1300, the ledger balance ends at 20,000,000 - 45,000,000 = -25,000,000. The balance sheet still ties (total_assets 197,169,996 == liabilities 48,000,000 + equity 149,169,996) because double-entry is intact, so balanced=true masks the defect. financial_engine.ratios computes quick_assets = current_assets - bal['1300'], and subtracting a negative makes quick_ratio (9.19) exceed current_ratio (7.8). Fix: book material purchases (debit 1300 / credit 1100 or 2000) before consumption, or set the opening inventory above total consumption. Import truncation: server.py returns only df.head(20) as 'preview' and Import.js commits that same array, so files larger than 20 rows lose rows silently while the success screen reports 0 skipped — reproduced with a 25-row CSV (row_count=25, imported=20, skipped=0).
